title: Murder
text: Whoever commits murder shall be punished in accordance with law. Distinctions with culpable homicide depend on intention, knowledge, and factual circumstances.

title: Bail in non-bailable offences
text: Courts evaluate gravity of offence, risk of absconding, tampering with evidence, and broader interests of justice while considering bail.

title: Divorce
text: A marriage may be dissolved by decree of divorce on specified grounds such as cruelty, desertion, conversion, unsoundness of mind, and other statutory grounds.

title: Divorce under Special Marriage Act
text: Petition for divorce may be presented on grounds including adultery, desertion, imprisonment, cruelty, or mental disorder as provided by the statute.

act: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005
title: Monetary reliefs
text: Magistrate may direct monetary relief to meet expenses and losses suffered, including maintenance, consistent with a fair and just determination.
